title: Calgary
subtitle: Calgary, a cosmopolitan Alberta city with numerous skyscrapers, owes its rapid growth to its status as the centre of Canada’s oil industry. However, it’s still steeped in the western culture that earned it the nickname “Cowtown,” evident in the Calgary Stampede, its massive July rodeo and festival that grew out of the farming exhibitions once presented here.

title: Grand Canyon
location: Grand Canyon, United States of America
subtitle: Grand Canyon National Park, in Arizona, is home to much of the immense Grand Canyon, with its layered bands of red rock revealing millions of years of geological history. Viewpoints include Mather Point, Yavapai Observation Station and architect Mary Colter’s Lookout Studio and her Desert View Watchtower. Lipan Point, with wide views of the canyon and Colorado River, is a popular, especially at sunrise and sunset.

title: Istanbul
subtitle: Istanbul is a captivating city where Europe and Asia meet, offering a rich blend of history, culture, and modern energy. Once the capital of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires, it is home to iconic landmarks such as Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Istanbul provides an unforgettable journey through centuries of history while remaining one of the world's most dynamic and fascinating cities.

title: Los Angeles
location: Los Angeles, United States of America
subtitle: Los Angeles is a sprawling Southern California city and the center of the nation’s film and television industry. Near its iconic Hollywood sign, studios such as Paramount Pictures, Universal and Warner Brothers offer behind-the-scenes tours. On Hollywood Boulevard, TCL Chinese Theatre displays celebrities’ hand- and footprints, the Walk of Fame honors thousands of luminaries and vendors sell maps to stars’ homes.

title: Nashville
subtitle: Nashville is the capital of the U.S. state of Tennessee and home to Vanderbilt University. Legendary country music venues include the Grand Ole Opry House, home of the famous “Grand Ole Opry” stage and radio show. The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum and historic Ryman Auditorium are Downtown, as is the District, featuring honky-tonks with live music and the Johnny Cash Museum, celebrating the singer's life..

title: Orlando
subtitle: Orlando is one of the world's leading family holiday destinations, best known for its world-famous theme parks and year-round sunshine. Home to Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando Resort, and SeaWorld, the city offers unforgettable entertainment for all ages. Beyond the parks, visitors can enjoy shopping, dining, golf courses, natural springs, and nearby attractions such as the Kennedy Space Center. Orlando serves as an ideal base for exploring Central Florida and creating lasting holiday memories.

title: Penang
subtitle: Penang is a vibrant Malaysian island renowned for its rich cultural heritage, colonial architecture, and outstanding cuisine. At its heart lies George Town, a UNESCO World Heritage city filled with historic buildings, street art, temples, and diverse communities. Visitors enjoy world-famous hawker food, scenic viewpoints, tropical landscapes, beaches, and a relaxed atmosphere.

title: Port Vila
subtitle: Vanuatu, officially the Republic of Vanuatu, is an archipelagic country in Melanesia located in the South Pacific Ocean. The archipelago, which is of volcanic origin, is 1,750 km east of northern Australia, 540 km northeast of New Caledonia, east of New Guinea, southeast of Solomon Islands, and west of Fiji.

title: San Diego
location: San Diego, United States of America
subtitle: San Diego is a city on the Pacific coast of California known for its beaches, parks and warm climate. Immense Balboa Park is the site of the renowned San Diego Zoo, as well as numerous art galleries, artist studios, museums and gardens. A deep harbor is home to a large active naval fleet, with the USS Midway, an aircraft-carrier-turned-museum, open to the public.

title: San Francisco
location: San Francisco, United States of America
subtitle: San Francisco, California, famously known as the City by the Bay, is a vibrant, hilly metropolis situated on the tip of a peninsula in northern California. Flanked by the Pacific Ocean to the west and the San Francisco Bay to the east, it is renowned for its iconic Golden Gate Bridge, historic cable cars, diverse cultural neighborhoods, and its legacy as a hub for progressive movements and tech innovation.

title: Tijuana
subtitle: Tijuana is a border city in Mexico, just south of California. Its bustling main street, Avenida Revolución, is lined with souvenir shops and lively bars. Landmarks include the neoclassical Jai Alai Frontón palace and Centro Cultural Tijuana, a modern cultural complex in the Zona Río district. Throughout town, stadiums stage lucha libre (wrestling) matches, while the nearby city of Rosarito fronts sandy beaches.

title: Yokohama
subtitle: Yokohama blends modern waterfront attractions with rich maritime heritage, offering vibrant shopping, diverse dining, and iconic landmarks. From the bustling Minato Mirai district to historic Chinatown and scenic harbor views, it provides a captivating mix of culture, history, and contemporary urban charm.
